name: tartinerlabs-mods
description: Claude Code mods — live panes, prompt bands, status line entries, toasts, and tool-call hooks

plugins.name: token-weather
plugins.description: A live forecast of the context window, drawn above the prompt.

plugins.name: auto-session-name
plugins.description: Names each session from its first prompt, so it is easy to find in /resume.

plugins.name: cache-clock
plugins.description: A countdown to the prompt cache going cold, drawn above the prompt.

plugins.name: auto-resume
plugins.description: Sends "continue" once a usage limit resets, so a cut-off turn picks up where it stopped.

plugins.name: limit-watch
plugins.description: The 5-hour and weekly usage limits above the prompt, coloured by use, with reset countdowns and toasts at 80% and 95%.

plugins.name: smart-compact
plugins.description: Compacts between turns when the context is full enough, sooner after a commit, PR, approved plan or finished todo list, or when the prompt cache is about to go cold or the 5-hour limit runs low.

plugins.name: release-notes
plugins.description: Drafts App Store release notes for Xcode projects when the version is bumped, into fastlane metadata or CHANGELOG.md.

plugins.name: resource-watch
plugins.description: Which session is using each booted Apple simulator, Claude Design project and the Xcode app, above the prompt, messaging the other session when two want the same one.

plugins.name: git-status
plugins.description: The branch, working tree and pull request above the prompt, toasts when checks finish, and /merge for single PRs and gh-stack stacks.

plugins.name: youtube
plugins.description: Reads the YouTube links in a prompt with yt-dlp and hands Claude each video's title, channel, description, chapters and transcript.
